who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor of R3 (/tmp/plan/6b-restart-rest.md), int-1112
what: R3's rule (a), 'a crate a maintainer holds state for is never served again in that process', read literally stops all serving: the lowering's batch runs nameres's maintainer over every crate before the first serve, so every crate is 'held' by then; and the impls maintainer's prepare registers every crate whose impls are not tables-served, a served def map without tables too.
cost: a design pass to find the condition; the planned ImplsMaintained check was dropped
cause: 'maintained' is not one fact: the maintainers hold state for crates they were never asked to keep, and the serve had no memory of what it was asked before
class: a rule phrased on an observable that other code sets for its own reasons
prevention: the serve keeps its own record (`Asked`, the database's write-side state) of what it was asked; rule (a) is 'asked before by a serve of this database and maintained by nameres (not paged)'
fix: serve leaves out a crate asked before and maintained, keeps its key so a store writes it; tests a_maintained_crate_is_not_served_again (control: a fresh database is served it).
